Definition: from G1909 and a derivative of G1062; to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way:--marry.
BiblicalUsage: Epigambreuo means to marry the widow of a brother, the levirate marriage — to raise up seed unto a brother. The Sadducees quote Moses to Jesus: if a man die having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up seed unto his brother.
TheologicalSignificance: A brother's line was not to die out for want of someone to stand in, and the law shows how seriously God takes a name continuing.
